subject: Request: one-off credit carveout for Catalyst Labs batch
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@catalystlabs.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: special credits for upcoming cohort

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Catalyst Labs is lining up our fall batch (Sept 8 start) and a few of our founders want to prototype using Redwood but they fall just outside your standard startup tiers. We have 12 teams but only 6 would be active on day one; projected first-month token burn estimate ~2.5M (primarily embeddings + light generation).

Is there room for a one-off promotional credit package or starter stipend (rather than the full Accelerator credits) plus a short-term volume discount for the pilot? Budget is tight and we’d like to avoid complex procurement for a pilot cohort.

Specific asks:
- A one-time pool of credits usable across multiple orgs (transferable within the cohort)
- 25–30% price reduction for the first month if volume hits the 2.5M token threshold
- Simple billing — single invoice to Catalyst rather than separate invoices per startup

Happy to share a short MA (mutual action plan) and expected usage sheet if that helps. Appreciate any flexibility — Catalyst has sent 4 startups your way previously and we’d like to keep them on Redwood for production once they graduate.

Best,
Sara
Founder Programs, Catalyst Labs

---
Attachment: cohort_estimates.xlsx (stated)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@catalystlabs.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: special credits for upcoming cohort

Hi Sara — thanks for outlining this. I chatted with Marcus (sales lead on programs) and Dev (finance) internally. High level: we can do a one-time pooled credit plus a timeboxed pilot discount, but I need to confirm a few operational points so we can scope the paperwork cleanly.

Can you confirm:
- Will Catalyst be the billing entity for the cohort (one invoice) or do you want individual startups invoiced and Catalyst to reimburse?
- Do you need the credits to be transferrable between startups after issuance, or should they be attached to orgs we create under a single Catalyst account?
- Is there any SOC2 / procurement paperwork we should anticipate before billing?

Assuming Catalyst will take a single invoice, our standard pilot carveout is: a one-time credit pool (we typically do $7–15k) + up to 30% off list for 30 days if usage crosses the agreed token threshold. I’ll confirm exact credit amount and legal wording after Marcus/finance weigh in.

If that sounds acceptable, I can prepare a short amendment and a simple billing addendum today.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

Laura — quick internal note. Pricing levers we can use here without exec sign-off:
- One-time credit pool up to $12k (legal just needs a short amendment)
- Pilot discount up to 30% for 30 days tied to a token threshold
- Billing to Catalyst as a single payer requires a simple reseller/trial agreement (small legal time)

Questions for finance: Dev, can we structure the credits as a single coupon code that applies across child orgs under Catalyst? If not, what’s easiest operationally (pooled account vs per-org credits)? Also, if we commit to the 30% discount, we should cap the liability — suggest a $25k max discount exposure for the pilot.

If those constraints work, I’ll draft the amendment and the billing addendum for Laura to send. We should attach promo terms (I’ll mock a doc).

—Marcus

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: special credits for upcoming cohort

Looping in replies from finance/proc. Short answers:
- We can implement a single pooled credit tied to the Catalyst master account and redeemable by child orgs; that is operationally simplest.
- Coupon code that deducts tokens at redemption is more prone to manual reconciliation; pooled credits are preferred.
- We can accept a volume discount for 30 days but need a liability cap; $25k cap is fine.
- For billing: we should issue one invoice net 30 to Catalyst. Procurement wanted to know if Catalyst requires a PO — if yes, add that to the addendum.

I attached a quick credit schedule and a draft "pilot promo terms" PDF for legal readability.

—Dev
